name: Fungal Rock
summary: At Un'Goro Crater's northeastern cliff, gorillas make their den in Fungal Rock. Ghost Mushrooms grow in its damp passages, among the crater's most dangerous ape dens.

sections.title: The Ape Den
sections.body: A waterfall and pool mark Fungal Rock's entrance on Un'Goro Crater's northeastern edge. Massive gorillas make their den in the damp underground corridors. Un'Goro Stompers and Thunderers move among Ghost Mushrooms there. Deep inside, the silverback U'cha and the albino gorilla Uhk'loc hold their territory. Near the cave mouth, a curious traveler may find A-Me 01, a damaged mechanical ape abandoned by gnome researchers.

faq.answer: Fungal Rock's damp passages cut into Un'Goro Crater's northeastern wall. Ghost Mushrooms grow among the hostile gorillas in its caves.

faq.q: Who rules the apes inside Fungal Rock?
faq.answer: U'cha, a massive silverback, rules Fungal Rock's deepest chamber. The rare white gorilla Uhk'loc also roams the caverns.

faq.q: Why is there a mechanical gorilla outside the cave?
faq.answer: A-Me 01 rests near the pool outside Fungal Rock's entrance. Dwarf researcher Karna Remtravel built the mechanical ape, which broke down during field observations and awaits salvage or repair.

faq.q: What valuable resources grow in Fungal Rock?
faq.answer: Ghost Mushrooms grow in Fungal Rock's damp, shaded interior. It is one of the few places in southern Kalimdor where herbalists can gather this sought-after fungus.

angles.text: At Fungal Rock, you can gather Ghost Mushrooms, though territorial gorillas guard the cavern passages.
As a gnome, you may want to investigate A-Me 01, Karna Remtravel's mechanical ape prototype, left near the entrance pool.
